title: 第二十五章 前驱和搭档第二十六章 唱作俱佳
lines: 真是有其主必有其仆……他是不是应该用实际行动好好教育一下主仆三人，不要相信外貌呢？张寿不自觉地认真考虑这个问题，最后决定，他还是别白费劲了。
唉，以后用实际行动来教育她们好了……
屋子里，流银仗着朱莹素来偏宠她几分，大胆地问道：“小姐，要是查出来婚约是真的，那你真的嫁给寿公子吗？”
“死丫头，竟敢打趣我，我看是你想嫁人！哼，我只是觉得他很知心而已，没想过其他！”
在门口听了这么一会儿壁角，张寿不得不重重咳嗽了一声，这才进了屋子。才一跨进门槛，他就只见嘻哈打闹的一主二仆正襟危坐，随即朱莹就用嗔怒的态度岔开了话题。
“阿寿，说句不好听的，我从小就常惹上烂桃花。那些成天围着我转的那些家伙，全都是些不成器的纨绔子弟。陆三郎在家里是老幺，爹不管娘宠着，上头有能干的大哥二哥，真要有大本事早显出来了，你别太高看他。”
“那些但凡有一点出息的贵介子弟，家里母亲姐妹都防我和防贼似的，成天在外宣扬我除了出身赵国公府再加一张祸国殃民的脸，不过绣花枕头一包草。所以，是不是会被我这张脸迷住，然后在我周围晃悠，常常被某些人用来区分正人君子和纨绔子弟。”
见张寿面露异色，朱莹把心一横，索性把话说开了：“但是，陆三郎这样的人没什么大本事，小心眼却多得很，一个不留神就容易被他们算计！你是不知世间险恶的竹君子，对谁都是真心实意，可千万别被他骗了，离陆三郎那个猪头远一点，肯定没错！”
再一次被朱莹当成单纯轻信易上当的世外人士，张寿已经连辩解的兴致都没了。反正，能因为相貌就让人降低对他的防备，是好事不是坏事，他不吃亏。
然而，偏偏在这时候，他就只听流银冷不丁插了一句嘴。
“小姐，就算陆三郎真的有什么算计，那也没什么要紧吧？有您给寿公子撑腰，陆三郎能耍什么花招？再说就算咱们老爷和大少爷听着好像有些麻烦，可您背后是太夫人，太后皇上也都会帮着您的，怎么会被人轻易算计了去。万一花七爷发起疯来，陆三郎算什么！”
流银话音刚落，朱莹却没答话，而是急忙扭头盯着张寿。见他没有生气，而是若有所思地冲着自己看了过来，她不禁仍有些担心流银这番太过露骨的话是不是惹恼了他。
“流银姑娘说得没错，有赵国公府大小姐镇宅，我何必畏首畏尾？”
张寿是觉得这桩所谓婚约很可疑，是觉得两家门不当户不对，可他从来不曾因此就觉得低了朱莹一头。此时此刻，他笑语了一句后，便泰然自若地对朱莹颔首道：“这次本来就是因为有你在，有你撑腰，否则，我怎么敢算计这些出身贵介的豺狼虎豹？”
听到张寿这么说，朱莹只觉得心情好极了，当即想都不想就做出了决定。
“那不如这样，阿寿你干脆只管在后头出主意，我在前头给你顶着！陆三郎要敢有什么算计，惹火了我，鞭子抽他一顿不算完，我再去太后和皇上面前哭一场，看谁有好果子吃！”
张寿不因为她的家世而低眉折腰，不因为她的家世而愤世嫉俗，敢当面向她借钱，敢坦言要利用她的身份做点事，自始至终都是平平淡淡面对她，真是很难得！
好容易才有这么个知心朋友，就让她为君前驱好了！
而面对这样赤诚的宣言，张寿在最初的一愣过后，不禁莞尔。
平生第一次见巾帼英豪主动冲锋陷阵，让男人在后头坐享其成的！
笑过之后，他见湛金殷勤得在一张搭着棉质椅袱的椅子上摆了坐垫，知道这是特意请自己过去坐，他也不客气，上前坐下之后，就笑着摇了摇头：“你的好意我心领了。这次事情是我挑起来的，哪能让你去顶雷？”
没等朱莹坚持，他就呵呵一笑，岔开了这个话题。
“其实还有一件事，我刚刚还没来得及说。虽说这没有任何依据，但我有个感觉，你二哥对和陆家结亲也许很热衷，但陆三郎那个人，很可能只是装个样子。一个才刚对流银百般讨好，死皮赖脸求见你的人，因为解难题解出了兴致，就不理会流银，这不大正常。”
流银顿时有些不服气：“说不定那时候他是故意做给我看，希望我回来告诉大小姐呢？”
“所以我说了，这只是我的一个感觉。”
张寿若有所思地摩挲着光洁的下巴，轻声说道，“你们说过，陆三郎在京城没什么好名声，作为陆家幺儿，他两个兄长很有出息，可他仿佛就没有任何优点。可实际上，他精于算数，甚至还在藏拙，那么，装出对莹莹神魂颠倒的样子，那是不是也有其他目的？”
朱莹甚至忘了张寿终于又叫了自己的小名，一时柳眉倒竖，“我是最讨厌那些家伙成天围着我转，可竟然借着我当挡箭牌，他把我朱莹当成什么了？”
“他也许是想着，围着你的狂蜂浪蝶多他一个不多，少他一个不少，既然世人都瞧不起他，正好悄悄打自己的小算盘。他之前一开口就愿意拿出那么多束修给我诚恳求学，我还没答应他，眼下想想，要不要我们两个一搭一档配合一下，去诈一诈他试试？”
一听到这个，朱莹顿时把起初那点小小的愤怒丢到了九霄云外，兴致盎然地连连点头道：“这主意不错！虽然你说那猪头挺聪明的，可耳听为虚眼见为实，我得亲自去看看！”
湛金和流银对视一眼，虽然觉得这是个有趣的主意，可对小姐的回答，她们却着实有些犯嘀咕。什么叫耳听为虚，眼见为实啊，小姐这岂不是对寿公子说不相信他的话吗？
“那现在就去！”
见朱莹行动力太强，说着就要往外走，张寿哭笑不得，立刻起身上前阻拦：“你先别急。陆三郎今天才刚到，让他先在翠筠间住一个晚上，吹吹山里的凉风，然后再吃顿没有荤腥的饭，清清肠胃，静下心情之后，我们再见他岂不是正好？”
“对啊，让他吃点苦头，清心寡欲，了无生趣之后，才能见人心！”朱莹喜上眉梢地双手一合，却是迸出了两个完全不搭界的成语，心里却深切了解了张寿的意思。
要是明明觉得苦透了，还要留下来学什么算学，那陆三郎肯定就是假猪头，真狐狸。要知道他平日吃一点苦就叫苦连天溜之大吉，绝不是什么有耐性的人！
content_en:
It is true that like a master, like a servant...Should he use practical actions to educate the three masters and servants not to believe in appearances? Zhang Shou unconsciously considered this issue carefully, and finally decided that he should not waste his efforts.
Alas, let’s educate them with practical actions in the future...
In the room, Liu Yin took advantage of Zhu Ying's favoritism and asked boldly: "Miss, if the engagement is found to be true, will you really marry Mr. Shou?"
"Damn girl, how dare you tease me? I think you want to get married! Huh, I just thought he was very close to me, I didn't think about anything else!"
After listening to the corner at the door for a while, Zhang Shou had to cough heavily before entering the room. As soon as he stepped through the threshold, he saw a master and two servants sitting in a hip-hop and noisy manner, and then Zhu Ying changed the topic with an angry attitude.
"Ah Shou, to put it bluntly, I have often been in trouble since I was a child. Those guys who surround me all day long are all incompetent playboys. Lu Sanlang is the youngest in the family, and his father does not care about his mother. He has capable eldest and second brothers above him. If he really has great abilities, he will have already shown his talent. Don't think too highly of him."
"Those noble children who have some potential, their mothers and sisters at home are as wary of me as they are of thieves. They advertise all day long that besides being born in the Duke of Zhao's palace, I also have a face that brings disaster to the country and the people. I am nothing more than a bag of embroidered pillows. So, will they be fascinated by my face, and then hang around me? It is often used by some people to distinguish between gentlemen and dandy children."
Seeing the strange expression on Zhang Shou's face, Zhu Ying became worried and spoke simply: "However, people like Lu Sanlang don't have much ability, but they are very petty. If you are not careful, you can easily be plotted by them! You are a bamboo gentleman who does not know the dangers of the world. You are sincere to everyone, but don't be deceived by him. Stay away from that pig head of Lu Sanlang. You are definitely right!"
Once again being treated by Zhu Ying as a simple and gullible outsider, Zhang Shou no longer even had the interest to defend himself. Anyway, being able to make people lower their guard against him because of his appearance is a good thing, not a bad thing, and he won't suffer.
However, at this moment, he only heard Liu Yin suddenly interrupt.
"Miss, even if Lu Sanlang really has some plot, it doesn't matter, right? With you backing Mr. Shou, what tricks can Lu Sanlang do? Besides, even if our master and eldest young master sound like they are in some trouble, you have the madam and the queen mother behind you. How can you be easily plotted? What if Mr. Hua Qi goes crazy? What does Lu Sanlang mean!"
As soon as Liu Yin finished speaking, Zhu Ying did not answer, but quickly turned to stare at Zhang Shou. Seeing that he was not angry, but looked at her thoughtfully, she couldn't help but still worried that Liuyin's too explicit words had offended him.
"Miss Liuyin is right. With the eldest daughter of Duke Zhao's house in charge of the house, why should I be timid?"
Zhang Shou felt that this so-called marriage contract was suspicious and that the two families were not in the same family, but he never felt that he was inferior to Zhu Ying because of this. At this moment, after he said something with a smile, he calmly nodded to Zhu Ying and said: "This time is all because of your presence and your support. Otherwise, how could I dare to plot against these jackals and tigers and leopards who came from noble families?"
Hearing what Zhang Shou said, Zhu Ying felt very good and made a decision immediately without thinking.
"It's better than this. Ah Shou, you can just come up with ideas from the back, and I'll support you from the front! If Lu Sanlang dares to have any plans and makes me angry, I'll whip him once. I'll go cry in front of the Queen Mother and the Emperor to see who gets the good news!"
Zhang Shou didn't bow his eyebrows or be cynical because of her family background. He dared to borrow money from her face to face, and he dared to admit that he wanted to use her status to do something. He always faced her calmly, which is really rare!
It’s not easy to find such a close friend, let her be the pioneer for you!
Faced with such a sincere declaration, Zhang Shou couldn't help but smile after being stunned for the first time.
For the first time in my life, I saw a heroine take the initiative to charge into battle, leaving the man behind to enjoy the victory!
After laughing, he saw that Zhan Jin had diligently placed a cushion on a chair with a cotton chair. Knowing that he was specially invited to sit there, he was not polite. After he went up and sat down, he smiled and shook his head: "I understand your kindness. I was the one who provoked this incident. How can I let you take the blame?"
Before Zhu Ying could insist, he chuckled and changed the topic.
"Actually, there is one more thing that I haven't had time to say just now. Although there is no basis for this, I have a feeling that your second brother may be very enthusiastic about marrying the Lu family, but Lu Sanlang is probably just pretending. It is not normal for a person who just tried to please Liu Yin in every possible way and shamelessly asked to see you to ignore Liu Yin because he became interested in solving a difficult problem."
Liuyin was immediately a little unconvinced: "Maybe he did it to me on purpose at that time, hoping that I would come back and tell the eldest lady?"
"So I said, this is just a feeling I have."
Zhang Shou stroked his smooth chin thoughtfully and said softly, "You said that Lu Sanlang doesn't have a good reputation in the capital. As the youngest son of the Lu family, his two brothers are very promising, but he seems to have no merit. But in fact, he is good at calculations and even hides his clumsiness. So, does pretending to be infatuated with Yingying have other purposes?"
Zhu Ying even forgot that Zhang Shou finally called her by her nickname again, and her eyebrows stood up for a moment, "I hate those guys hanging around me the most, but they actually used me as a shield. What does he think of me, Zhu Ying?"
"He may be thinking that if you have more bees and butterflies around you, he will not be more than him, and if you are less than him, he will be just a small calculation. Since the world looks down on him, he is secretly planning his own little plan. When he opened his mouth before, he was willing to give me so many cultivators to sincerely ask for help, but I haven't agreed to him yet. Now I'm thinking, should we work together as a team and try to deceive him?"
As soon as she heard this, Zhu Ying immediately threw away her little anger at the beginning, nodded repeatedly with great interest and said: "This is a good idea! Although you said that pig head is quite smart, hearing is false and seeing is believing. I have to go and see for myself!"
Zhan Jin and Liu Yin looked at each other. Although they thought it was an interesting idea, they were actually a little embarrassed by the young lady's answer. What does it mean to listen to what you hear and what you see to believe? Isn’t this the young lady telling Mr. Shou that she doesn’t believe what he says?
"Then go now!"
Seeing that Zhu Ying was too strong and about to walk out, Zhang Shou couldn't laugh or cry, so he immediately got up and stepped forward to stop him: "Don't worry. Lu Sanlang just arrived today. Wouldn't it be nice to let him stay in Cuiyun Room for one night to enjoy the cool breeze in the mountains, and then eat a meal without meat and fish, clear his stomach, and calm down before we see him again?"
"That's right, let him suffer some hardships, be free from desires, and lose all interest in life before he can see people's hearts!" Zhu Ying clasped her hands together with joy, but she came out with two completely unrelated idioms, but she understood Zhang Shou's meaning deeply in her heart.
If he still wanted to stay and learn arithmetic even though he was feeling so miserable, then Lu Sanlang must be a fake pig head but a real fox. You must know that he usually complains about the pain and runs away after a little hardship. He is definitely not a patient person!
title_en: Chapter 25: Pioneer and Partner Chapter 26: Excellent Singing and Composition
